quests.question: You want to travel by train to visit a friend in another city. Who drives the train and keeps it on schedule?
quests.hint: You want to travel by train to visit a friend in another city. Who drives the train and keeps it on schedule?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a train driver. Train drivers safely drive trains along the tracks.
quests.funFact: A train driver has to know every station along a very long route!
quests.wordExample: The train driver announced the next station.

quests.question: You wonder how your favorite app always knows exactly what to do when you tap it. Who wrote the code for that?
quests.hint: You wonder how your favorite app always knows exactly what to do when you tap it. Who wrote the code for that?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a programmer. Programmers write the code that makes computers and apps work.
quests.funFact: Programmers often test their code many times to fix small mistakes.
quests.wordExample: The programmer fixed a small mistake in the game's code.

quests.question: You found an unusual, shiny rock and want to know exactly what it's made of. Who could tell you?
quests.hint: You found an unusual, shiny rock and want to know exactly what it's made of. Who could tell you?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a geologist. Geologists study rocks and the layers that make up the Earth.
quests.funFact: Geologists study how mountains and canyons formed over millions of years.
quests.wordExample: The geologist studied a rock she found near the mountain.

quests.question: You're hiking a trail in a big park and have a question about which path leads back. Who could help you?
quests.hint: You're hiking a trail in a big park and have a question about which path leads back. Who could help you?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a park ranger. Park rangers protect nature and help visitors in parks.
quests.funFact: A park ranger can name almost every plant and animal in their park!
quests.wordExample: The park ranger explained the park's hiking rules.

quests.question: You just sat down at a restaurant table and you're hungry. Who comes over to take your order?
quests.hint: You just sat down at a restaurant table and you're hungry. Who comes over to take your order?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a waiter. Waiters bring food and drinks to your table at a restaurant.
quests.funFact: A busy waiter can remember many food orders at the same time!
quests.wordExample: The waiter brought our food to the table.

quests.question: This person builds sturdy walls using brick and stone, not wood. Are they a mason or a carpenter?
quests.hint: This person builds sturdy walls using brick and stone, not wood. Are they a mason or a carpenter?
quests.explanation: Nice work! This is a mason. Masons build walls and structures using brick or stone.
quests.funFact: A mason lines up each brick so carefully that walls stay strong for years!
quests.wordExample: The mason spread cement between each brick.

quests.question: You see a beautiful, colorful painting hanging on a gallery wall. Who created it?
quests.hint: You see a beautiful, colorful painting hanging on a gallery wall. Who created it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an artist. Artists paint and draw pictures full of color and imagination.
quests.funFact: Artists mix colors together to create thousands of new shades!
quests.wordExample: The artist painted a colorful picture of the sunset.

quests.question: Your soccer team needs someone to teach new plays and cheer everyone on. Who does that?
quests.hint: Your soccer team needs someone to teach new plays and cheer everyone on. Who does that?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a coach. Coaches teach and guide a team to play a sport well.
quests.funFact: Coaches plan practice games to help their team improve every week.
quests.wordExample: The coach taught us a new way to pass the ball.

quests.question: You're having trouble seeing the board clearly at school. Who could test your eyes and help you get glasses?
quests.hint: You're having trouble seeing the board clearly at school. Who could test your eyes and help you get glasses?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an optician. Opticians test people's eyes and help them choose the right glasses.
quests.funFact: An optician uses a special chart with letters that get smaller and smaller.
quests.wordExample: The optician asked me to read the smallest letters on the chart.

quests.question: Someone has to decide exactly how a movie should look and tell the actors what to do. Who is that?
quests.hint: Someone has to decide exactly how a movie should look and tell the actors what to do. Who is that?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a film director. Film directors guide the actors and crew to make a movie.
quests.funFact: Film directors work closely with hundreds of people to make one movie.
quests.wordExample: The film director explained the scene to the actors.

quests.question: This person writes the words of a storybook, not the pictures inside it. Are they an author or an illustrator?
quests.hint: This person writes the words of a storybook, not the pictures inside it. Are they an author or an illustrator?
quests.explanation: That's right! This is an author. Authors write books for people to read and enjoy.
quests.funFact: Some authors write the same story over and over until it feels just right.
quests.wordExample: The author signed copies of her new book.

quests.question: This person's main job is studying ocean animals and how they behave. Are they a marine biologist or a diver?
quests.hint: This person's main job is studying ocean animals and how they behave. Are they a marine biologist or a diver?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a marine biologist. Marine biologists study the plants and animals that live in the ocean.
quests.funFact: Marine biologists sometimes discover brand-new sea creatures no one has seen before.
quests.wordExample: The marine biologist tagged a sea turtle to track its journey.

quests.question: The flowers in the park look so bright and colorful all year. Who plants and waters them?
quests.hint: The flowers in the park look so bright and colorful all year. Who plants and waters them?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a gardener. Gardeners plant and take care of flowers, plants, and trees.
quests.funFact: Gardeners know exactly how much water and sun each plant needs.
quests.wordExample: The gardener watered the flowers every morning.

quests.question: You want to learn how to exercise safely and build up your strength. Who could guide you one-on-one?
quests.hint: You want to learn how to exercise safely and build up your strength. Who could guide you one-on-one?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a personal trainer. Personal trainers help one person exercise safely and reach their fitness goals.
quests.funFact: Personal trainers cheer their clients on to help them try their best.
quests.wordExample: The personal trainer planned a new workout for the week.

quests.question: You wonder exactly where the sweet honey on your morning toast comes from. Who collects it?
quests.hint: You wonder exactly where the sweet honey on your morning toast comes from. Who collects it?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a beekeeper. Beekeepers take care of bees and collect the honey they make.
quests.funFact: A beekeeper wears a special suit and veil to work safely near bees.
quests.wordExample: The beekeeper checked on the busy hive.

quests.question: This person shapes wet clay on a spinning wheel into bowls and cups, rather than carving stone. Are they a potter or a sculptor?
quests.hint: This person shapes wet clay on a spinning wheel into bowls and cups, rather than carving stone. Are they a potter or a sculptor?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a potter. Potters shape clay into bowls, cups, and other pottery.
quests.funFact: A potter spins clay on a wheel to shape it into a bowl!
quests.wordExample: The potter painted a pattern on the finished vase.

quests.question: This person writes brand-new music for others to play, rather than performing it themselves on stage. Are they a composer or a musician?
quests.hint: This person writes brand-new music for others to play, rather than performing it themselves on stage. Are they a composer or a musician?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a composer. Composers write original music for others to play or sing.
quests.funFact: Some famous composers wrote music that orchestras still play today.
quests.wordExample: The composer wrote a cheerful new song for the choir.

quests.question: The _____ used a magnifying glass to see the small parts.
quests.hint: The _____ used a magnifying glass to see the small parts.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a watchmaker. Watchmakers build and repair watches with tiny, careful parts.
quests.funFact: A watchmaker works with gears so tiny they're smaller than a grain of rice!
quests.wordExample: The watchmaker used a magnifying glass to see the small parts.

quests.question: You're watching someone perform incredible flips and balances at the Olympics. Who trained for years to do that?
quests.hint: You're watching someone perform incredible flips and balances at the Olympics. Who trained for years to do that?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a gymnast. Gymnasts perform flips, jumps, and balances that take years of practice.
quests.funFact: A gymnast can balance on a beam thinner than a shoe!
quests.wordExample: The gymnast balanced carefully on the beam.

quests.question: You want to learn how to read a brand new book all by yourself. Who helps you practice at school?
quests.hint: You want to learn how to read a brand new book all by yourself. Who helps you practice at school?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a teacher. Teachers help children learn new things every day.
quests.funFact: Teachers plan fun lessons to help students learn new things every day.
quests.wordExample: The teacher wrote the new words on the board.

quests.question: This person performs music on an instrument for a live audience, rather than writing the original song. Are they a musician or a composer?
quests.hint: This person performs music on an instrument for a live audience, rather than writing the original song. Are they a musician or a composer?
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a musician. Musicians play instruments to create music.
quests.funFact: Some musicians can play more than one instrument really well.
quests.wordExample: The musician practiced the drums every afternoon.

quests.question: The _____ crossed the colorful threads on her loom.
quests.hint: The _____ crossed the colorful threads on her loom.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a weaver. Weavers cross threads together on a loom to make cloth.
quests.funFact: A weaver can turn plain thread into cloth with beautiful patterns!
quests.wordExample: The weaver crossed the colorful threads on her loom.

quests.question: You're lost in a busy place and need help finding your way back to your family. Who could you ask for help?
quests.hint: You're lost in a busy place and need help finding your way back to your family. Who could you ask for help?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a police officer. Police officers keep neighborhoods safe and help people follow the rules.
quests.funFact: Some police officers ride bicycles or horses while they work!
quests.wordExample: The police officer helped us cross the busy street.

quests.question: You're on a beach vacation and really want to learn how to surf. Who could teach you?
quests.hint: You're on a beach vacation and really want to learn how to surf. Who could teach you?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a surf instructor. Surf instructors teach people how to ride ocean waves on a surfboard.
quests.funFact: A surf instructor teaches beginners to catch small, gentle waves first!
quests.wordExample: The surf instructor helped me stand up on the board.

quests.question: Your school pants have gotten too long and need shortening. Who could fix that for you?
quests.hint: Your school pants have gotten too long and need shortening. Who could fix that for you?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a tailor. Tailors sew and fix clothes so they fit just right.
quests.funFact: A tailor measures your body carefully so clothes fit perfectly.
quests.wordExample: The tailor measured my shoulders for a new suit.

quests.question: The _____ helped explain the contract to her client.
quests.hint: The _____ helped explain the contract to her client.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a lawyer. Lawyers help and speak for people who need help with the law.
quests.funFact: A lawyer reads carefully through many papers before every case.
quests.wordExample: The lawyer helped explain the contract to her client.

quests.question: The sole on your favorite shoe came loose and needs fixing. Who could repair it?
quests.hint: The sole on your favorite shoe came loose and needs fixing. Who could repair it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a cobbler. Cobblers make and repair shoes.
quests.funFact: Cobblers once made every single pair of shoes in a town by hand.
quests.wordExample: The cobbler stitched the torn shoe back together.

quests.question: A sculptor can spend months carefully carving a single statue!
quests.hint: A sculptor can spend months carefully carving a single statue!
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a sculptor. Sculptors carve or shape material like stone or metal into art.
quests.funFact: A sculptor can spend months carefully carving a single statue!
quests.wordExample: The sculptor shaped the clay model before starting the real statue.

quests.question: You want to know the name of the bird singing outside your window every morning. Who could identify it?
quests.hint: You want to know the name of the bird singing outside your window every morning. Who could identify it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an ornithologist. Ornithologists study birds and their behavior.
quests.funFact: An ornithologist can often identify a bird just by hearing its song!
quests.wordExample: The ornithologist recognized the bird by its song.

quests.question: The _____ repeated the speech in a different language.
quests.hint: The _____ repeated the speech in a different language.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is an interpreter. Interpreters listen in one language and speak the meaning in another right away.
quests.funFact: An interpreter has to think and translate at almost the same time someone is speaking!
quests.wordExample: The interpreter repeated the speech in a different language.
